assign.outcome:
**Four small provenance follow-ups landed, each proven headless.**

1. **Inline styles as a row** — `defined($el)` in `ext/layout/body.js` now lists `[...el.style]` at the top of the css group, labelled `inline — written by JS`, only when the element has any. Proven on `layout()`'s own wall: `--gap: 1em; --column: 14em;` — declarations `cssdoc.rules()` cannot see.
2. **The two-up: both panes selectable** — `layout.selectable($el)` exported from `ext/layout/layout.js` (`= region`); `ext/demo/layout.js` now runs `$views.forEach(panel.selectable)` and toggles context on `$stage`. `.layout-region` count on `/framework/styles/layouts/docs/` is 2 (was 1); a click in the right pane selects inside it instead of deselecting.
3. **`layout.selected()`** — one-line accessor in `panel.js`, surfaced on `layout`. `dev/DevBar/ask.js` `selection()` now also matches `.layout-selected`, confirmed by DOM read on a live selection (no import of `ext/layout` added).
4. **Lock + part link** — `framework`/`lew42` rows get a small `lock` glyph (Material Icons, renders as the glyph); every part label is now a link — framework → `/framework/styles/`, lew42 → `/framework/styles/layers/`, any other part → its own module dir, derived from the sheet's own href (never hard-coded to `ext/`).

![drawer with the inline row and a locked, linked framework rule](drawer-inline.png)

**Headless (1280, dev socket blocked, Playwright):** zero console errors on `/framework/ext/layout/`, `/framework/styles/layouts/docs/`, `/framework/dev/DevBar/`; `doc/selection/` loads clean at 1600 with no `.md-error`.

**Left, on purpose:** pane 0 of the two-up ends up region'd twice (bar + forEach) — harmless, noted as a Watch-out; lew42's link verified via `cssdoc.rules()` on a live `h1` (same code path as framework, not re-screenshotted).
